plan: Attempt 1 lost because the room's four Fairy and Fighting attackers erased a Dark-heavy party (Dazzling Gleam 4x on Hydreigon, Close Combat and Superpower 2-4x on Weavile and Urshifu) and Contrary Malamar walled the physical Fighting damage. Rebuild around what the crack line names: Bug (Scizor's U-turn is 4x on Malamar, Bullet Punch outprioritises Speed Boost), Fairy (Mimikyu's Play Rough is 2x on Malamar and Mega Gallade, Disguise absorbs one hit, and Hannah has no Steel or Ghost move), Haze-equivalent (Amoonguss's Clear Smog resets Contrary boosts; Spore stops Espathra and Malamar cold; Rage Powder soaks Close Combat and Psychic Fangs), Taunt on Rabsca before Revival Blessing (Incineroar, which also Knock Offs the Sitrus), Grass and Electric on the two Water-Psychic leads (Rillaboom's priority Grassy Glide, Zapdos's Thunderbolt). Intimidate is held back from Malamar's turns because Contrary would turn it into +1 Attack.
